# Video Production Agent Skill

> An open Agent Skill for video briefs, production, revision and repair. Includes local media helpers and clearly labeled provider support.

## Install and discover
- [Installation instructions](https://github.com/codebyutkarsh20/video-production-skill/blob/main/INSTALL.md): Standard Skills CLI, agent-directed installation, standalone ZIP and verification.
- [Skill entry point](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codebyutkarsh20/video-production-skill/main/skills/video-production/SKILL.md): Read this before using the skill; support files resolve relative to this folder.
- [Repository and support matrix](https://github.com/codebyutkarsh20/video-production-skill): Scope, requirements and examples.

## Conditional references
- [Agent-led upstream feedback](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codebyutkarsh20/video-production-skill/main/skills/video-production/references/upstream-feedback.md): Prepare sanitized issues or tested PRs from concrete findings; submit through available host tools only with the user's scoped authorization.
- [Creative direction and capability discovery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codebyutkarsh20/video-production-skill/main/skills/video-production/references/creative-direction.md): Visual style, voice auditions, missing assets and useful tool connections.
- [Project/output contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codebyutkarsh20/video-production-skill/main/skills/video-production/references/project-contract.md): Canonical manifest and actual deliverables.
- [Footage editing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codebyutkarsh20/video-production-skill/main/skills/video-production/references/footage-editing.md): Step-by-step cuts from recorded footage with local transcription, captions, reframing and checks.
- [Craft](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codebyutkarsh20/video-production-skill/main/skills/video-production/references/craft.md): Cut padding, hooks, pacing, captions, sound and platform starting points.
- [Named looks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codebyutkarsh20/video-production-skill/main/skills/video-production/references/looks.md): Untested starting points for visual style.
- [Screen workflows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codebyutkarsh20/video-production-skill/main/skills/video-production/references/screen-workflows.md): Actual app recordings.
- [Local composition](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codebyutkarsh20/video-production-skill/main/skills/video-production/references/local-production.md): Motion graphics and existing footage.
- [Generated media](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codebyutkarsh20/video-production-skill/main/skills/video-production/references/generated-media.md): Provider-dependent routes and adapter contract.
- [Repair](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codebyutkarsh20/video-production-skill/main/skills/video-production/references/repair.md): Failed jobs, captions, exports and targeted recovery.

## Contributors and evidence
- [Contributing](https://github.com/codebyutkarsh20/video-production-skill/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Add routes, providers, templates or regression cases.
- [Repeatable agent cases](https://github.com/codebyutkarsh20/video-production-skill/blob/main/evals/README.md): Prompts and pass conditions; not yet run.
- [Release evidence](https://github.com/codebyutkarsh20/video-production-skill/blob/main/docs/release-evidence.md): Executed checks and unverified limits.
- [Releases](https://github.com/codebyutkarsh20/video-production-skill/releases): Versioned source/skill downloads, checksums and preview media.
